extracted.name: Cottage Cheese Banana Pancakes
extracted.description: This cottage cheese banana pancake recipe is packed with protein and flavored with brown sugar and cinnamon. And, it's super easy to make in a blender.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat a griddle or large skillet over medium heat.
Combine oats, protein powder, brown sugar, cinnamon, and baking powder in a blender; blend until fine then transfer to a large bowl.
Combine banana, cottage cheese, eggs, and vanilla extract in a blender; blend until smooth.
Add banana mixture to oat mixture; stir into a thick batter. Stir water into batter to thin as desired.
Ladle ¼ to ½ cup batter per pancake onto the preheated griddle or skillet.
Cook until browned on bottoms, 3 to 5 minutes; flip and cook until browned on other sides and centers are set, 3 to 5 minutes more.
